def transform(grid):
    n, m = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cw = [[grid[n - 1 - r][c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(m)]
    ccw = [[grid[r][m - 1 - c] for r in range(n)] for c in range(m)]
    half = [[grid[n - 1 - r][m - 1 - c] for c in range(m)] for r in range(n)]
    return [grid[r] + cw[r] for r in range(n)] + [ccw[r] + half[r] for r in range(n)]

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test = [[1,6,2,4,1],[3,9,9,9,9],[9,9,3,9,9],[0,2,9,5,4],[7,9,9,9,9]]
    print(transform(test))
